The '''Malsuum Expanse''' was a desert on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malsuum]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Hock Malsuum|CT-5539]] was marooned in the Malsuum Expanse.<ref name="DVatCoS1" />
